objective: maximize cumulative user profit and learning speed while minimizing user intervention
corePrinciples: Do not optimize for item count; optimize for cumulative profit, average order value, conversion evidence, and repeatable demand.
Do not publish plaintext paid assets to GitHub.
Do not infer public product URLs; verify them independently before linking from funnels.
Do not reactivate KDP or LINE without explicit user instruction.
Prefer automation that reduces ongoing user labor rather than adding setup burden.
Use current official platform fees and rules at each production or pricing decision.

layer1FreeAcquisition.goal: capture high-intent searches and route only to verified relevant paid products
rules: Each free tool must solve a real standalone problem.
Add one non-intrusive paid CTA only after the paid product URL is verified.
Use title, meta description, FAQ, sitemap, and internal links for organic discovery.
Avoid ad monetization until meaningful traffic exists.

layer2PaidEntry.goal: convert problem-aware users with low decision friction

layer3CoreProducts.goal: sell reusable tools that reduce work time, omissions, or decision errors

layer4Bundles.discountRule: 10-20% below the sum of complementary standalone products
layer4Bundles.activation: create when at least two complementary products exist and their public URLs or queue integrity are confirmed
layer4Bundles.goal: increase average order value without creating near-duplicate products

layer5OrganizationLicenses.activation: create organization/team-use editions for proven practical OS or bundles, with explicit internal-use license terms and the same core files plus organization license
layer5OrganizationLicenses.goal: capture higher willingness to pay from clubs, NPOs, event teams, small organizations, and businesses
rules: Do not promise legal, tax, safety, or compliance outcomes.
Keep personal and organization license terms clearly separated.
Prefer a separate BOOTH product over complicated manual fulfillment.

noteMembership.activationSignal: meaningful repeat paid readership or follower demand; do not launch merely because the feature exists
noteMembership.conceptDirection: monthly practical templates, operating systems, and implementation notes for students/small organizations
noteMembership.reason: note officially supports membership with no initial/monthly creator fee and a 10% platform fee before payment-processing/withdrawal fees

layer7GlobalCrossListing.status: defer until a Japanese product proves demand

candidates.useCase: English-localized digital templates and optional tips/membership
candidates.currentFeeNote: 5% shop/membership service fee plus normal Stripe/PayPal processing; no listing fee
candidates.trigger: a BOOTH product reaches at least 5 observed sales or clear demand evidence

candidates.useCase: English-localized digital downloads with affiliate/coupon capability
candidates.currentFeeNote: Free Forever plan 5% transaction fee plus payment-processor fees
candidates.trigger: a proven product has a localization-ready buyer problem

candidates.useCase: global discovery for higher-priced bundles only
candidates.currentFeeNote: direct/profile sales 10% + $0.50 plus processing; Discover sales 30%
candidates.trigger: use only if discovery upside justifies materially higher fees

layer8AffiliateRevenue.status: one-time partner signup required before activation

priorityOpportunity.currentPublicOffer: 50% recurring commission on Payhip revenue generated by referred sellers
priorityOpportunity.fit: existing creator-pricing tools and future digital-product comparison content
priorityOpportunity.rule: affiliate disclosure required; recommendations must remain evidence-based and not distort comparisons

layer8AffiliateRevenue.activation: after user completes unavoidable affiliate-account enrollment; then add tracked links only to relevant content

layer9DirectPayments.currentPublicFeeNote: Payment Links has no additional platform fee; standard successful card payment fee shown by Stripe Japan is 3.6%
layer9DirectPayments.useCase: organization-license payments, tips, or subscriptions only after secure digital fulfillment is solved
layer9DirectPayments.rule: do not expose paid download files behind an unprotected static success URL

booth.currentOfficialFeeAssumption: download product price x 5.6% + 45 JPY per order, decimals rounded up; reconfirmed 2026-08-19 against BOOTH's 2025-10-28 fee revision notice
booth.publicationSemantics: enabled/queued is not published; only a publication-ledger record with publicUrlVerified=true may be treated as public/completed

pipelineStatus.productionDecision: deprioritize new BOOTH queue load until Windows consumer catches up

portfolioRules.bundleDiscountTarget: 10-20% below sum of complementary standalone products
portfolioRules.freeLite: only add a paid-product CTA when its live public URL has been independently confirmed

noSaleReview.after30Days: review title, preview, positioning, and funnel before lowering price
noSaleReview.after60Days: consider bundling, repackaging, or retiring; do not keep producing clones

winnerExpansion.after3Sales: prioritize one complementary product or bundle experiment
winnerExpansion.after5Sales: evaluate organization license and English localization
winnerExpansion.after10Sales: evaluate a higher-value bundle, recurring offer, and cross-platform listing

funnels.purpose: creator pricing intent; future affiliate/direct-product funnel

futureMonetizationReview: Payhip partner affiliate program after enrollment
Ko-fi/Payhip English cross-listing after proven demand
Stripe direct payments only with secure fulfillment
sponsorship/advertising on free tools only after meaningful traffic
ads only after traffic is large enough that UX cost is justified
